_comments: The BizApps Tasks Application — what makes Tasks a first-class citizen of MemberJunction Explorer
rather than a set of loose components.
DefaultNavItems is the top tab bar representing the four core views:
1. Tasks Dashboard (Gantt, Kanban, List switcher with status KPIs and filters)
2. My Tasks (User-focused pending deliverables & due dates)
Each item is ResourceType 'Custom' pointing at a DriverClass registered with

fields.Name: Tasks
fields.Description: Comprehensive task management, sub-task breakdowns, Kanban workflows, Gantt scheduling, multi-person assignments, and template automation across MemberJunction.
